meta.summary: 14 new today — the standouts fill the thin back-half of the window. Top pick: On-Device AI Hackathon: Cleared for Takeoff (Liquid AI × Qualcomm — build a project that runs ENTIRELY on-device, test it offline; SF, Nov 13 — 5/5). Plus a 2nd ODSC × Nebius Hackathon (Dec 29, free, GPU credits — rare late-Dec coverage). From Open Source AI Week (Oct 16–24): Crusoe Field Day build-train-deploy (Oct 16), Cline & Composio open-source-agents hackathon (Oct 19), Fine-Tune LLMs & run on-device with GenieX (Oct 19, Santa Clara), LMCache hands-on inference-efficiency workshop (Oct 22), Training Agents IRL at GitHub (Oct 22), Google Gemma Hardware Hackathon (Oct 24, Hillsborough). Also: Ship Happens (Nov 7) and AI Research Hackathon (Nov 7–8). THIS WEEK (Oct 14–21): TODAY Oct 14 — Wiki3 'Own Your Own AI' at Hacker Dojo (5/5) + Fast Forward hackathon + Oakland Claude Code; Oct 16 — Open Together: AI Builders Unite (5/5, Hugging Face) + Crusoe Field Day; Oct 17 — ExecuTorch Hackathon (5/5) + Recursive Agents (4/5); Oct 19 — Cline & Composio + GenieX on-device fine-tune + Universal Hackathon + Open Weight Debate Night; Oct 20 — Software Projects with AI at Hacker Dojo + Oakland Claude Code; Oct 21 — Open Infra Night for Agent Builders.
gaps: Luma calendar pages don't render dates server-side (JS-only), so dates for several new Luma-sourced events (Crusoe Field Day, Cline & Composio, LMCache, Open Infra Night, Adaptive Software, Agent Builders Demo Night) were taken from the Open Source AI Week aggregator or left needsVerification:true — confirm time/venue before relying on them.

Recurring watch-series still have no next dated instance: Vibe Coding Nights (past), Vibe Night Demos (now #30 but FULL, no date), SF Demo Night (#16 was Feb, past), Punk Software Hack Night (#9 past), AI Tinkerers SF (no upcoming SF date — last SF event ~4 weeks ago).

Voxel51 / SF Frontier Tech list many Nov–Dec sessions (incl. a Nov 19 LeRobot 'hands-on workshop' and Nov 5/11, Dec 10 meetups) but they are ONLINE Zoom — skipped per policy (online webinars rank last). SF Physical AI Oct 28 (Antler, in-person) is the one that's tracked.

Frontier Tower members-only placeholders with NO dates posted now also include TestMu AI Hackathon, NerdConf Stranger Builds, Builderbase Dell×NVIDIA, and Voice AI for Real Life — kept only the two already-tracked (Cline, Dell×NVIDIA); the rest on watch.

ODSC AI West (Oct 27–29) and the AI X Leadership Summit are paid conferences — excluded; the free hands-on pieces are the ODSC × Nebius hackathons (Oct 28 + new Dec 29). The Oct 22 ODSC 'AI for Work' online webinar was skipped (webinar).
comfy.org still shows the ComfyUI Build Night only as past (Oct 13) with no reschedule; its sole upcoming listing is an LA Tech Week panel (out of area).

Back-half (mid-Dec → Jan 12) remains thin: only Devnovate Dec events (AI Demo Night Dec 4, Agentic AI Hackathon 2.0 Dec 15) and the new ODSC × Nebius (Dec 29) reach that far. DeveloperWeek 2027 hackathon starts Jan 25 — just outside the 90-day window.

South Park Commons in-window is mostly firesides/forums (talks) or Bengaluru events; the one SF item (Bio-Data Hackathon Demos, Oct 18) is a demo/prizes showcase, not a build night. Noisebridge has no AI/ML events in-window.
